proponi.consigliatoAiuto: The expected date has passed, so a follow-up is recommended.
proponi.aiuto: The AI writes a draft for you to review. Nothing is sent without your confirmation.

esiti.email_non_trovata: This email is no longer available.
esiti.attesa_non_trovata: This waiting item no longer exists.
esiti.attesa_non_attiva: This waiting item is closed, so there is nothing to follow up.
esiti.casella_non_pronta: No connected mailbox can send this. Reconnect it in Settings.
esiti.nessun_destinatario: There is nobody to write to: every recipient is one of your own addresses.

descrizione.risposta: A reply written in the language of the email. Review it, edit it and confirm before anything is sent.
descrizione.sollecito: A follow-up to your request, written in its language. Review it, edit it and confirm before anything is sent.

generazione.spiegazione: The AI is writing a draft in the language of the email. This page updates on its own.
generazione.inRitardo: This is taking longer than usual
generazione.inRitardoTesto: You can keep waiting or ask for a new draft.
generazione.inPausaTesto: Resolve it in Settings, then regenerate the draft: a paused draft doesn't restart on its own.
generazione.fallita: The AI couldn't write the draft
generazione.fallitaTesto: You can ask for a new draft.

esiti.non_modificabile: This draft can no longer be changed.

editor.oggettoAiuto: Keep the suggested subject to stay in the same Gmail thread.
editor.rivediAiuto: Save your changes before you review the send.
editor.nuovaVersione: A newer version of this draft was saved elsewhere. Your text is still here.
editor.caricaUltima: Discard my changes and load it

esiti.versione_superata: This draft changed since you opened it. Load the latest version, then apply your changes again.
esiti.non_modificabile: This draft is being sent or was sent, so it can no longer be changed.

busta.fissa: Recipients and mailbox are set by the app from the email headers and can't be changed.
busta.casellaNonPronta: This mailbox can't send right now. Reconnect it in Settings.

reply_to_dominio_diverso.titolo: Replies go to a different domain
reply_to_dominio_diverso.testo: The email asks for replies at an address on a different domain from the sender's. Make sure you trust it.

destinatari_nuovi.testo: Some recipients weren't part of this thread.

possibile_duplicato.testo: A previous attempt may already have been delivered. Sending again could deliver the same message twice.

contesto.descrizione: The app chose these emails; the AI read only these.
contesto.nessuna: You wrote this version: no emails were given to the AI.

conferma.descrizione: This is exactly what will be sent. Nothing leaves your mailbox until you press Send now.

esiti.gia_in_corso: This draft is already being sent.
esiti.versione_superata: The draft changed since this page was opened.
esiti.casella_non_pronta: The mailbox can't send right now. Reconnect it in Settings.
esiti.bozza_vuota: The draft has no message or no recipients.
esiti.errore: Something went wrong. Nothing was sent. Try again.

invio.inCorsoTesto: Confirmed and on its way. This page updates on its own.
invio.fallitoTesto: Nothing left your mailbox. You can edit the draft and send it again.
invio.verificaTesto: We're looking for it in your sent mail until <ora></ora>. You can decide after that; deciding earlier could create a duplicate.
invio.incerto: We couldn't confirm whether it left
invio.incertoTesto: It hasn't appeared in your sent mail. Check the Sent folder in Gmail, then tell us what happened.
invio.nonInviatoDomanda: Mark it as not sent and unlock the draft?
invio.reinviaDomanda: The first attempt may have been delivered, so sending again could create a duplicate. Continue?

annullato.utente_non_inviato: You marked the previous attempt as not sent.
annullato.utente_reinvia: You chose to send again. Review the draft and confirm a new send.

esitiDecisione.non_incerto: The outcome is now known: the page has been updated.
esitiDecisione.in_verifica: We're still checking. You can decide in a few minutes.

erroriInvio.non_inviato: The send wasn't picked up in time
erroriInvio.busta_modificata: The draft changed after you confirmed it
